name: The National Mall, Washington DC
note: The east two-thirds of the National Mall's axis, from the World War II Memorial and the head of the Lincoln Memorial Reflecting Pool past the Washington Monument and the Smithsonian museums to the US Capitol and its West Front, with the White House, the Federal Triangle, the Tidal Basin and the Jefferson Memorial on the flanks. Scale 0.42 blocks per metre, a 3.33 km square (1397 blocks a side): the whole 3.9 km axis to the Lincoln Memorial would need 0.36, where the Capitol's dome is 11 blocks across, so the stronger half (Monument to Capitol) is kept at a scale where the hero buildings read.
